title: המילה שלא אמרת
emotional_truth: the warm thing you feel about someone is worth more when it's said, not just felt

forbidden: romantic coercion or confessions that ignore a 'no'
contacting someone who asked for space
any message that endangers self or others
safety.notes: All levels are consent-first and safe. The warmth is offered, never demanded. Success is saying it — never how the other person answers, or whether they answer at all.
